                             LINE FORMAT

                          YOUR       POSSIBLE
  ID  ITEM                CHOICE     CHOICES

  a   Line Spacing        1          1 = Single  2 = Double  3 = Triple
                                     4 = Half    5 = 1 and 1/2
  b   Line Alignment      1          1 = Left    2 = Justify
                                     3 = 1/2 Justify
  c   Typestyle Number    86         1 - 31 (10 pitch)
                                     80 - 111 (12 Pitch)
                                     154 - 175 (Proportional)
                                     215 - 230 (15 Pitch)
  d   Lines/cm or in.     2          1 = 2.09/cm or 5.3/in.
                                     2 = 2.36/cm or 6/in.   3 = 3.15/cm or 8/in.
                                     4 = 9.45/cm or 24/in.  5 = 2.0/cm or 5.08/i
  e   Adjust Line Endings 1          1 = Yes     2 = No
  f   Zone Width          6          1 - 30
When finished with this menu, press ENTER.

Type ID letter to choose ITEM; press ENTER:
